mapper.select: SELECT FROM cut_cutover_configuration_revision WHERE id = #{query.configurationRevisionId} AND tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE cut_cutover_configuration_revision SET configuration_name = #{row.configurationName}, change_summary = #{row.changeSummary}, navigation_target_code = #{row.navigationTargetCode}, version = version + 1, updater = #{row.updater}, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{row.id} AND tenant_id = #{row.tenantId} AND version = #{row.version} AND status_code = 'DRAFT' AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM cut_cutover_configuration_revision WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND status_code = 'PUBLISHED' AND effective_start_time <= #{query.effectiveAt} AND (effective_end_time IS NULL OR effective_end_time > #{query.effectiveAt}) AND deleted = b'0' ORDER BY configuration_code ASC, revision_no DESC, id DESC
